quiz.title: A few quick questions
quiz.intro: Four taps. If a question doesn't fit you, choose “Not sure”: it's skipped, not counted.
quiz.privacy: Your answers stay in this browser tab.

veins.prompt: Look at the veins on the inside of your wrist. They look…

daylight.prompt: In daylight, does your skin look more…

metal.prompt: Which looks better next to your face?

white.prompt: Which suits you better: pure white or off-white clothing?

summary.title: Your answers
summary.later: Your results will use these answers together with your photo.

depth.mstApprox: About {value} on the Monk Skin Tone scale (approximate)

notes.photoQuizDisagree: Your photo and your answers pointed in different directions, so we're less sure. Both metal families may work for you.
notes.lowPhotoConfidence: The photo gave us limited information, so your answers count for more.
notes.noQuizAnswers: This result is based on your photo only. Answering the questions makes it more reliable.
notes.bothCanWork: Both metal families can work for you, so go with what you love.
notes.bothCanWorkUncertain: Both metal families can work for you. For a clearer result, retake your photo in daylight, hold up a sheet of white paper to calibrate, and answer any questions you skipped.

necklaces.fine-pendant: A fine chain with a small pendant
necklaces.pendant: A pendant on a mid-length chain

finishes.lighter: Fine pieces and brushed or satin finishes look soft on lighter skin. High polish adds sparkle when you want it.
finishes.medium: Most finishes work for you: polished for shine, brushed for a softer look. Fine and bold pieces both suit you.
finishes.deeper: High-polish finishes and bolder pieces stand out beautifully on deeper skin. Fine pieces look lovely layered.

summary.cool: Your skin reads cool in this analysis, so cool, white metals are your easiest match.
summary.neutral-cool: Your skin reads neutral with a slight cool lean: cool metals come first, and warm metals work too.
summary.neutral: Your skin reads neutral, so warm and cool metals both suit you, and mixing them works well.
summary.neutral-warm: Your skin reads neutral with a slight warm lean: warm metals come first, and cool metals work too.
summary.warm: Your skin reads warm in this analysis, so warm, golden metals are your easiest match.
summary.uncertain: We couldn't tell clearly enough whether warm or cool metals suit you better, so we show both side by side.

favoured.best: Matches the way your skin tone leans, so it looks effortless.
favoured.good: Matches your skin tone's lean; a softer choice than your top picks.
favoured.care: From the right metal family for you, but a less usual match. Try it as an accent.

other.best: From the other metal family, and still a great match for you.
other.good: From the other metal family, and still easy to wear with your skin tone.
other.care: A less natural match for your skin tone. Wear it in small doses or mix it with your best metals.

mixed.best: Mixing metals bridges warm and cool, so it suits you well.
mixed.good: Lets you wear your best metals together with the others.
mixed.care: Works best when one of your best metals leads the mix.

balanced.best: Both metal families can work for you, and this is one of the easiest to wear.
balanced.good: Can work for you; a softer choice than the top picks.
balanced.care: A less usual match. Try it as an accent.

footer.note: Style guidance based on colour analysis, not a measurement.

hero.lede: Upload a selfie taken in daylight. ToneMatch reads your skin's tone and undertone right on your device, then suggests metals, styles and gemstones that suit you.
hero.privacy: Your photo never leaves your device

photo.title: Take a daylight selfie
photo.body: Face a window. No flash, no filters, glasses off, hair away from your face.

quiz.title: Answer four quick questions
quiz.body: Your veins, your skin in daylight, and the colours you reach for. Each one can be skipped.

palette.title: Receive your palette
palette.body: Metals ranked for you, with styles, gemstones and an honest confidence score.

privacy.title: Your photo stays with you
privacy.body: The analysis runs entirely in your browser. Nothing is uploaded, saved or shared, and the photo is discarded when you leave the page.

nothingStored.title: Nothing stored
nothingStored.body: No photo, no profile, no tracking.

photo.hint: JPG, PNG or WebP · one face · natural light

errors.empty: That file is empty. Please choose another photo.
errors.heic: This is an HEIC photo (the iPhone format), which we can't read yet. Please choose a JPG or PNG. Tip: on iPhone, photos picked from the Photos library are converted automatically.
errors.unsupported: We can't read this file. Please choose a JPG, PNG or WebP photo.
errors.tooLarge: This photo is larger than {max} MB. Please choose a smaller one.

items.window: Face a window in daylight. Avoid direct sun and lamps.
items.flash: Turn off the flash, filters and beauty modes.
items.glasses: Take off glasses, including tinted ones.
items.hair: Keep hair away from your cheeks and forehead.
items.cheeks: No makeup on your cheeks if possible: it changes their colour.
items.straight: Just you in the photo, looking straight at the camera.

status.download: A one-time download of about {size} MB. Your browser keeps it for next time.
status.slow: This is taking a while. On a slow connection the first download can take a minute or two.
status.onDevice: All of this happens on your device.

blocked.NO_FACE: We couldn't find a face. Choose a photo where your whole face is visible and you're looking at the camera.
blocked.MULTIPLE_FACES: We found more than one face. Choose a photo with just you in it.
blocked.NOT_ENOUGH_SKIN: We couldn't see enough of your cheeks and forehead. Move closer and keep your hair away from your face.

report.reviewChoice: You can analyse it anyway, but your result will be less certain. A new photo usually gives a clearer answer.
report.removedNote: Your photo has been removed from this page. Only the results of the checks are kept.

FACE_TOO_SMALL.title: Your face is small in the photo
FACE_TOO_SMALL.tip: Move closer, so your face fills more of the frame.

TOO_DARK.title: The photo is too dark
TOO_DARK.tip: Face a window in daylight, or add more light.

TOO_BRIGHT.title: The photo is too bright
TOO_BRIGHT.tip: Avoid direct sun and flash. Soft daylight works best.

COLOR_CAST.title: The light is tinted
COLOR_CAST.tip: Lamps and coloured light shift skin colours. Daylight from a window works best.

BLURRY.title: The photo looks blurry
BLURRY.tip: Hold the camera steady and let it focus on your face.

HEAD_TILTED.title: Your head is turned or tilted
HEAD_TILTED.tip: Look straight at the camera, with your chin level.

done.title: Your photo was analysed and removed
done.body: Only a few colour numbers are kept, in this tab. They're gone when you start again or close the tab.
done.accepted: You chose to analyse it anyway, so your result will be less certain.

failed.load: The analysis tool didn't load. Check your connection and try again. Your photo is still only on this device.
failed.decode: Your browser couldn't open this file. Please choose another JPG, PNG or WebP photo.
